title: Teachmint vs Classplus (2026): Konsa Best Hai? Price Checked
description: Teachmint vs Classplus, konsa best hai? Official sites se price check: Classplus ₹29,999 saal, Teachmint price nahi dikhata. Kisko kya suit karta hai, fair comparison.
og_description: Teachmint ab AI classroom device se lead karta hai aur price publish nahi karta; Classplus ₹29,999 (1 saal) aur ₹39,999 (2 saal) dikhata hai. Dono ka fair comparison, aur AllCoaching teesre option ke roop mein.
keywords: teachmint vs classplus konsa best hai
h1: Teachmint vs Classplus: Konsa Best Hai? 2026 Ka Fair Comparison, Official Price Ke Saath
dek: Dono platforms ko unki apni website ke hisaab se tola gaya hai: kya karte hain, kitna price dikhate hain, kya nahi batate, aur kis tarah ke institute ko kaunsa suit karta hai. Saath mein ek teesra option bhi, jo aap khud set up karte ho.
cover_alt: Teachmint vs Classplus konsa best hai: Teachmint, Classplus aur AllCoaching ka comparison, official sites par price 24 Oct 2026 ko check
audience: India ke coaching institute owners, tutors aur school owners jo Teachmint aur Classplus ke beech chun rahe hain
intro: Teachmint vs Classplus mein best woh hai jo aapke kaam se match kare: Teachmint ab schools aur classrooms ke liye AI classroom device (Teachmint X) se lead karta hai, jabki Classplus coaching business ko branded app aur website ke saath online courses bechne deta hai. Agar aap coaching institute ho aur online courses bechna chahte ho, to Classplus ka offer zyada seedha fit hai, aur uska price bhi published hai: ₹29,999 ek saal ke liye. Teachmint apni website par koi price nahi dikhata; wahan demo book karna hota hai.

Ek teesra raasta bhi hai: apni academy khud banana, apne domain par website aur apne Android app ke saath (iOS app Pro monthly aur har yearly plan par). AllCoaching yahi karta hai, aur hum AllCoaching hain, isliye yeh guide padhte waqt yeh yaad rakhiye. Fair rakhne ke liye har price company ki apni website se liya hai, 24 Oct 2026 ki date ke saath, aur jahan Teachmint ya Classplus behtar fit hai, wahan seedha likha hai.
Yeh kisi ki burai nahi hai. Dono established platforms hain. Sawaal sirf itna hai ki aapke institute ke liye kaunsa sahi baithta hai.
takeaways: Classplus ₹29,999 (1 saal) aur ₹39,999 (2 saal) dikhata hai apne pricing page par (24 Oct 2026 ko check); GST, sales par fee aur renewal price wahan nahi likha.
Teachmint apni website par koi price nahi dikhata (24 Oct 2026 ko check); ab yeh Teachmint X, ek "AI-Powered Connected Classroom Device", se lead karta hai.
Online courses bechne wale coaching institute ke liye Classplus ka offer (Android app, website, admin portal, recorded courses, live classes) zyada seedha fit hai.
Schools aur classroom management ke liye Teachmint ka focus zyada match karta hai.

AllCoaching teesra option hai: har monthly plan (₹3,999, ₹5,999 ya ₹7,999 mahina) par 0% commission, yaani har sale ka 100% aapka; ya yearly Starter ₹6,999 saal + sales par 10%; har plan mein apna domain aur Android app (iOS app Pro monthly aur har yearly plan par); GST alag, 7 din free trial, card nahi.
Published prices par, saal ki lagbhag ₹2.3 lakh sales tak AllCoaching Classplus se sasta hai; usse upar Classplus ka flat price kaagaz par kam hai.
Faisle se pehle teen sawaal likhit mein poochhiye: GST, sales par fee, aur renewal price.

sections.h2: Humne Teachmint aur Classplus ko kaise compare kiya
sections.html:
Humne dono platforms ko unki apni website par jo likha hai, usi ke hisaab se dekha, aur AllCoaching ko teesre option ki tarah saath rakha. Paanch cheezein check ki.

  1. Kya bechte hain: unke apne shabdon mein.
  2. Published price: sirf company ke apne pricing page se.
  3. Kya nahi likha: GST, sales par fee, renewal, ise vendor se poochhne wale sawaal ki tarah.
  4. Aapka kya hai: apna domain, apna app, students ka data.
  5. Shuru kaise hota hai: khud signup ya demo aur sales call.

sections.h2: Teachmint aur Classplus asal mein kya hain
sections.html:
Teachmint aur Classplus dono education technology companies hain, par 2026 mein unki website alag cheez bechti dikhti hai.

Teachmint: classroom aur school ke liye

Teachmint ki website ab Teachmint X se lead karti hai, jise woh "AI-Powered Connected Classroom Device" kehta hai: ek interactive board aur EduAI tools, schools, higher education aur coaching ke liye. Website par koi plan ya price nahi hai; "Book a Demo" se shuruaat hoti hai.[2]

Achha kya hai: agar aapka institute physical classroom chalata hai aur smart board, teaching tools aur classroom management chahiye, to Teachmint ka focus wahi hai.

Kya check kariye: jo plan offer ho, woh online courses bechne wale coaching institute ke liye hai ya schools ke liye, aur saal ka total kitna hai.

Classplus: coaching business ke liye app aur website

Classplus ka page kehta hai "Get your own brand's teaching app, create your own website & sell courses". Plan cards par Android app, website, admin portal, unlimited recorded courses, live classes, student enrolments, storage aur "A.I. Powered Leads" listed hain.[1]

Achha kya hai: price published hai, aur coaching ke liye zaroori cheezein ek plan mein listed hain.

Kya check kariye: pricing page par GST, sales par fee aur renewal price nahi likha, aur plan cards par iOS app listed nahi hai. Yeh sab likhit mein poochhiye.

{{q:Kya Teachmint aur Classplus ek hi cheez hain?|Ab nahi. Dono education technology hain, par Teachmint ki website classroom device aur schools par focus karti hai, jabki Classplus coaching business ko branded app aur website se courses bechne par. Isliye pehle tay kariye ki aapko classroom tools chahiye ya online course business.}}

Dono mein common sawaal: students kahan se aayenge

Koi bhi software khud students nahi laata. Chahe Teachmint ho, Classplus ho ya AllCoaching, aapke main raaste aapke YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp groups, Google search aur offline batches hi rehte hain. Isliye platform chunte waqt dekhiye ki aapke brand ka naam kahan dikhta hai: aapke domain aur app par, ya platform ke.

{{fig:before-after|Pehle aur baad: demo ke baad price pata chalna, GST aur renewal saaf nahi, iOS app listed nahi, aur ek login mein apni website, Android app (iOS Pro ya yearly par), published price aur 7 din ka trial|Jo bhi chuno, poora price signup se pehle pata hona chahiye.}}

sections.h2: Teachmint, Classplus aur teesra option: ek-ek karke

Coaching business ke liye branded teaching app aur website; "Get your own brand's teaching app, create your own website & sell courses".

Hamara platform · disclosure

3. AllCoaching

Kis mein achha
Academy jo aap khud banate ho, coaching ke liye Shopify jaisa: signup, plan chuniye, course upload kariye, domain connect kariye aur bechna shuru. Apna Android app (iOS app Pro monthly aur har yearly plan par), YouTube Live ya Zoom par unlimited live classes aur UPI checkout har plan mein.

Monthly 0% commission par: Starter ₹3,999, Growth ₹5,999, Pro ₹7,999/mahina; ya yearly: Starter ₹6,999 + 10%, Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 + 5% sales par. Kisi plan par sales limit nahi; GST alag. Pricing[3]

Check kariye
Yearly Starter par 10% fee sales badhne ke saath jud jaati hai; saal ki lagbhag ₹2.3 lakh sales ke upar Classplus ka flat price kaagaz par kam hai. Lagbhag ₹4 lakh ke upar AllCoaching ka monthly plan (0% commission) aksar yearly Starter se zyada bachata hai. Classroom device jaisa hardware hum nahi dete.
Kiske liye best
Tutors aur institutes jinhe apna brand chahiye aur sab khud set up karna hai.

Fixed kharcha kam rakhiye aur trial se shuru kariye. Pehle ek course bechiye, phir bada plan sochiye. Teachers ke liye best coaching app guide aur options dikhati hai.

Badhta hua coaching institute

Apni asli sales par total compare kariye, aur dekhiye ki students ko aapka naam dikhta hai ya platform ka. Classplus ka best alternative guide chhe options compare karti hai.

Bada multi-branch institute

Steady aur zyada sales par Classplus jaisa flat price kharche mein jeet sakta hai. Multi-teacher zaroorat bhi dekhiye; AllCoaching mein alag teacher logins milte hain. Detail ke liye multi-teacher coaching platform padhiye.

School ya classroom-first institute

Agar smart classroom aur school operations main zaroorat hai, to Teachmint ka demo lijiye. Online selling ke liye Teachmint alternative wali guide bhi dekhiye.

faq: Teachmint vs Classplus, konsa best hai?

Aapke kaam par depend karta hai. Online courses bechne wale coaching institute ke liye Classplus ka offer zyada seedha fit hai, kyunki woh branded app aur website deta hai aur ₹29,999 saal ka price dikhata hai. Teachmint ab classroom device aur schools par focus karta hai aur price publish nahi karta.
Teachmint ya Classplus, kaunsa sasta hai?

Seedha compare nahi ho sakta, kyunki Teachmint apni website par price nahi dikhata (24 Oct 2026 ko check). Classplus ₹29,999 ek saal aur ₹39,999 do saal ke liye dikhata hai, GST aur sales fee ke bina likhe. Teachmint se demo mein likhit quote maangiye.
Teachmint ke pros aur cons kya hain?
Pro: classroom aur school ke liye Teachmint X device aur EduAI tools. Con: website par price nahi, demo se shuruaat, aur yeh saaf nahi ki plan online course sales ke liye bana hai ya schools ke liye.
Classplus ke pros aur cons kya hain?

Pro: published price, aur plan mein Android app, website, admin portal, recorded courses aur live classes listed. Con: pricing page par GST, sales fee aur renewal price nahi likha, aur plan cards par iOS app listed nahi.
AllCoaching Teachmint aur Classplus se kaise alag hai?

AllCoaching mein aap academy khud banate ho, bina sales call ke: apne domain par website aur apna Android app har plan mein, iOS app Pro monthly aur har yearly plan par. Monthly plans (₹3,999 mahina se) par 0% commission, ya yearly Starter ₹6,999 saal + sales par 10%, GST alag, 7 din free trial, card nahi chahiye.
Kya AllCoaching mein white-label app aur custom domain milta hai?

Haan. Har AllCoaching plan mein apne connected domain par website aur apna white-label Android app milta hai, aur Pro monthly aur har yearly plan par iOS app bhi, jo aap studio mein khud set up karte ho.
Bade multi-branch institute ke liye kya best hai?

Steady aur saal ki ₹2.3 lakh se kaafi upar sales par Classplus ka flat price kaagaz par sasta pad sakta hai. Classroom hardware chahiye to Teachmint ka demo lijiye. Apna brand aur alag teacher logins chahiye to AllCoaching ka trial chalaiye.
Teachmint ya Classplus se AllCoaching par kaise shift karein?

Nayi academy banaiye, current students ko batch khatam hone tak purane platform par rehne dijiye, naye admissions apni website aur app par bhejiye, phir records export karke purana plan renewal par khatam hone dijiye.
